query:
The right to privacy is the right of individuals to keep their personal actions and personal materials confidential and not to be illegally informed, in order to protect their reputation and image without violating the law.

The right of a suspected corruption offender to keep his source of income secret from the media is the right to privacy.

repl_history.response:
The Global Context Preview appears to contain both parts of the query. The preview describes privacy as protecting one's "reputation and image," and it then directly applies this concept to a suspect not wanting their source of income publicly revealed, stating it is the right to privacy.

Therefore, FINAL ANSWER: entitle
